data.name: 2026.09.1 : MCP for Your Whole Account
data.body: ## Availability | Feature | Community Edition | Cloud Free Plan | Paid Plans In Cloud/On-Prem | | --- | :---: | :---: | :---: | | Account-Wide MCP Connections | – | ✅ | ✅ | | Table Tools | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | Summarize in Timeline View | – | – | ✅ | | Track Specific Fields in Last Modified | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | YouTrack Sync | – | – | ✅ | Timeline View requires the Business plan and above on NocoDB Cloud, and App Sync requires the Plus plan and above. ## Account-Wide MCP Connections One MCP connection now reaches every base you pick, with the tools you allow and never more than your own role. The server now has 199 tools, 50 more than 2026.09.0, including member and team management, attachment upload, upsert, audit logs, trash restore, and publishing. [Learn more about MCP →](https://nocodb.com/docs/apis-and-mcp/mcp) ## Table Tools A single Tools button in the view toolbar opens fields, relations, permissions, webhooks, and every other table tool in one panel. --- [Learn more about Table Tools →](https://nocodb.com/docs/product/tables/table-operations/table-details) ## Summarize in Timeline View Show a count, sum, average, or other summary under each day, week, or month of a Timeline. [Learn more about Summarize →](https://nocodb.com/docs/product/tables/views/view-types/timeline#summarize) ## Track Specific Fields in Last Modified Last modified time and Last modified by fields can watch only the fields you choose. [Learn more about tracking specific fields →](https://nocodb.com/docs/product/tables/fields/field-types/date-time-based/last-modified-time#track-specific-fields) ## YouTrack Sync Sync [YouTrack](https://www.jetbrains.com/youtrack/) issues, comments, and users into NocoDB alongside the other ticketing sources. [Learn more about YouTrack sync →](https://nocodb.com/docs/product/sync/app-sync/ticketing#youtrack) ## Improvements - **Invite links** - Share one link to bring people into a base or workspace at the role you choose. [Learn more](https://nocodb.com/docs/product/collaboration/invite-links) - **Base settings as a modal** - Settings open over your current view, with search. [Learn more](https://nocodb.com/docs/product/bases/actions-on-base) - **Integrations page** - Your connections first, then one catalog grid with category filters. [Learn more](https://nocodb.com/docs/product/integrations) - **Webhook trigger fields** - Pick individual body, header, and query values in later steps. [Learn more](https://nocodb.com/docs/workflows/nodes/trigger-nodes/webhook) - **Variables in email links** - Send Email links can use workflow data as the address. [Learn more](https://nocodb.com/docs/workflows/nodes/action-nodes/send-email) - **Interface forms** - Mark fields *Required*, update the open record from a form, and manage a button's forms in place. [Learn more](https://nocodb.com/docs/interfaces/layouts/form) - **Interface filters** - Larger *Filter by* editor, with copy and paste between components. - **Large number abbreviation** - Number, Decimal, and Currency fields can display 1,234,567 as 1.2M. [Learn more](https://nocodb.com/docs/product/tables/fields/field-types/numerical/number#large-number-abbreviation) - **Excel exports** - Currency and Decimal export as real numbers. [Learn more](https://nocodb.com/docs/product/tables/table-operations/download) - **Faster menus** - Dropdowns open instantly. - **List View drag and drop** - Drops apply immediately. - **Bulk update** - Redesigned *Update selected records* panel. ## What's Fixed - **Grouped grids** - Rows stay in the right group after realtime updates. - **Select options** - Adding a new option by paste or typing keeps existing options. - **Imports, snapshots, and duplication** - Large tables and synced tables copy completely, and User values carry across workspaces. - **Interfaces** - Link values, visibility rules, link pickers, attachment downloads, and overview cover images work as expected. Published pages keep working after a field is deleted, and pasted link values stay on new rows. - **Bulk Update** - Updating all records fires webhooks and workflow triggers. - **Kanban** - Reordering cards within a stack is saved. - **Workflows** - Steps inside an Iterate loop get the current record when tested, and fields that combine several variables resolve correctly. - **Views** - Calendar and Timeline views without a date range duplicate correctly, and shared List views open. - **Renamed tables** - Formula display values keep working after a table rename. - **Audit log** - Filtering by *Data* events returns results. - **Documents** - Markdown with empty table cells pastes correctly. - **API** - `null` for a v3 link field leaves links unchanged, v2 `in` filters with several dates return every match, and base-scoped tokens can list their bases. - **MCP** - Removing someone from a base revokes only that base's connections, write tools accept what their read tools return, and records created from a template keep their links. - **Invites** - Invite emails on self-hosted and Community Edition deployments sign people up correctly, workspace invites in the Community Edition send an email, and resending a base invite works. - **Sign-in** - Brief network errors no longer sign you out, and self-hosted SSO buttons show again. - **SQL Server** - Single-argument `CONCAT` works. - **Airtable import** - One failing item no longer stops the import, and one-way links and nested filters import correctly. ## Self-Hosting Notes - **Faster loading** - Static files are cached and compressed, so first loads are about 3.6 times smaller. - **License server health** - Super admins see a warning with *Retry now* when the license server is unreachable. [Learn more](https://nocodb.com/docs/self-hosting/license-activation) - **v3 API field changes** - Currency options use `currency_code` and `currency_locale`, and form validators `minValue`, `maxValue`, and `custom` are rejected. - **CSV currency exports** - Currency values no longer include a thousands separator. - **Security hardening** - Stricter audit log access, sanitized filenames, and patched dependencies. --- For more details on the features introduced in 2026.09.0, see the [2026.09.0 changelog](https://nocodb.com/docs/changelog/2026.09.0). ----------- - [**closed**] 🐛 Bug: The web page loads incredibly slowly. [#14623](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14623) - [**closed**] 🐛 Bug: download CSV, JSON, XLSX must be downloaded to local disk not stored inside docker [#14617](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14617) - [**closed**] i18n: interpolation tokens translated or dropped in several locale strings (fr/it/pt/es) [#14573](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14573) - [**closed**] 🐛 Bug: Currency fields exported to Excel as text with U+202F thousands separator [#14563](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14563) - [**closed**] 🐛 Bug: [Docs] Private Base available in Business or Scale plan? [#14529](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14529) - [**closed**] Nocodb UI menus feels slow compared to competitors [#14499](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14499) - [**closed**] 🐛 Bug: Unable to delete or modify fields after creation [#14299](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14299) - [**closed**] 🐛 Bug: Random `ECONNREFUSED` to NocoDB Cloud API [#14279](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14279)

@@ -1,6 +1,14 @@
-import { CURRENT_USER_TOKEN, EventType, UITypes, isLinksOrLTAR } from 'nocodb-sdk'
-import type { FilterType, InterfaceFilterNode, LinkToAnotherRecordType, LookupType, RollupType, TableType } from 'nocodb-sdk'
-import { interfaceDataEventSuffix } from '~/lib/interfaceData'
+import { CURRENT_USER_TOKEN, EventType, UITypes, isLinksOrLTAR, parseProp } from 'nocodb-sdk'
+import type {
+  DataPayload,
+  FilterType,
+  InterfaceFilterNode,
+  LinkToAnotherRecordType,
+  LookupType,
+  RollupType,
+  TableType,
+} from 'nocodb-sdk'
+import { interfaceDataEventSuffix, isInterfaceSyntheticViewId } from '~/lib/interfaceData'
 
 const COMPUTED_DISPLAY_VALUE_TYPES = new Set<UITypes>([UITypes.Formula, UITypes.Lookup, UITypes.Rollup])
 
@@ -119,6 +127,34 @@ export function viewMembership(matchedViewIds: string[] | undefined, viewId: str
   return matchedViewIds.includes(viewId) ? 'in' : 'out'
 }
 
+/**
+ * A view's membership before a peer's update. The server's list covers saved filters only, so
+ * with ad-hoc client-side filters (search, URL `where`) an `in` is unknown; interface pages
+ * receive synthetic view ids the server never tags, and the server never lists a view filtered
+ * on the viewer (`@me`).
+ */
+export function previousViewMembership(
+  prevMatchedViewIds: string[] | undefined,
+  viewId: string | undefined,
+  hasClientSideRowFilters: boolean,
+  isViewerScopedView = false,
+): ViewMembership {
+  if (isInterfaceSyntheticViewId(viewId) || isViewerScopedView) return 'unknown'
+  const membership = viewMembership(prevMatchedViewIds, viewId)
+  return membership === 'in' && hasClientSideRowFilters ? 'unknown' : membership
+}
+
+/**
+ * How a peer's update to a row a view hasn't loaded moves the view's row count: `none` when
+ * it stayed in (or out), `add` when it entered, `remove` when it left, `unknown` without both
+ * memberships.
+ */
+export function unloadedRowCountChange(wasIn: ViewMembership, isIn: ViewMembership): 'none' | 'add' | 'remove' | 'unknown' {
+  if (wasIn === 'unknown' || isIn === 'unknown') return 'unknown'
+  if (wasIn === isIn) return 'none'
+  return isIn === 'in' ? 'add' : 'remove'
+}
+
 /**
  * What a grid does with a peer's update to a row it hasn't loaded: `ignore` it, reload only the
  * group header aggregations (`aggregates`: the row stayed in its group), or `refresh` in place
@@ -166,3 +202,189 @@ export function classifyUnloadedRowUpdate({
 export function hasViewerScopedFilter(filters: Array<{ value?: unknown }>): boolean {
   return filters.some((filter) => `${filter.value ?? ''}`.split(',').some((value) => value.trim() === CURRENT_USER_TOKEN))
 }
+
+const isSameMetaValue = (a: unknown, b: unknown) => {
+  if ((a ?? null) === (b ?? null)) return true
+  if (typeof a !== 'object' || typeof b !== 'object' || !a || !b) return false
+  try {
+    return JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b)
+  } catch {
+    return false
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Whether a peer's filter or sort row differs from the cached one. Only the server's keys are
+ * compared (the cache adds local state such as `status` or `children`), timestamps aside.
+ */
+export function isMetaRowChanged(cached: Record<string, any> | undefined, next: Record<string, any>): boolean {
+  if (!cached) return true
+  return Object.keys(next).some((key) => key !== 'created_at' && key !== 'updated_at' && !isSameMetaValue(cached[key], next[key]))
+}
+
+const pendingPeerViewReloads = new WeakMap<object, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()
+
+/** One quiet reload per view for a burst of peer filter/sort events, however many instances hear them. */
+export function schedulePeerViewReload(
+  hook: { trigger: (param: { shouldShowLoading: boolean }) => unknown } | undefined,
+  wait = 250,
+) {
+  if (!hook) return
+  clearTimeout(pendingPeerViewReloads.get(hook))
+  pendingPeerViewReloads.set(
+    hook,
+    setTimeout(() => {
+      pendingPeerViewReloads.delete(hook)
+      hook.trigger({ shouldShowLoading: false })
+    }, wait),
+  )
+}
+
+/** Whether a peer's edit to a cached RLS policy can change which rows are visible: a rename can't. */
+export function isRlsPolicyEditRowAffecting(prev: Record<string, any> | undefined, next: Record<string, any>): boolean {
+  if (!prev) return true
+  const { title: _prevTitle, ...prevRest } = prev
+  const { title: _nextTitle, ...nextRest } = next
+  return isMetaRowChanged(prevRest, nextRest)
+}
+
+/**
+ * Whether a peer's `table_update` changes what views of the table render from (fields, table
+ * meta, sync state), so the cached meta must be replaced rather than patched. A key the payload
+ * omits counts as unchanged.
+ */
+export function isTableStructureChanged(cached: Record<string, any>, next: Record<string, any>): boolean {
+  return (['columns', 'meta', 'synced'] as const).some((key) => {
+    if (!(key in next)) return false
+    if (key === 'meta') return !isSameMetaValue(parseProp(cached.meta), parseProp(next.meta))
+    return !isSameMetaValue(cached[key], next[key])
+  })
+}
+
+export type ViewColumnState = Record<string, any> & { show?: boolean | number; group_by?: boolean | number }
+
+/**
+ * Whether a peer's view-column change needs the view's data reloaded here: a field was shown
+ * (its values weren't fetched), or the grouping changed. Hiding, resizing or reordering doesn't.
+ */
+export function viewColumnsNeedReload(before: Record<string, ViewColumnState>, after: Record<string, ViewColumnState>): boolean {
+  const ids = new Set([...Object.keys(before), ...Object.keys(after)])
+
+  for (const id of ids) {
+    const prev = before[id] ?? {}
+    const next = after[id] ?? {}
+    if (next.show && !prev.show) return true
+    if (isGroupByChanged(prev, { group_by: false, ...next })) return true
+  }
+
+  return false
+}
+
+/**
+ * Whether a peer's update can change figures a view derives from `fieldTitles` across its rows
+ * (calendar active dates, timeline summaries): not for a row outside the view before and after,
+ * nor for one that stayed in it without any of those fields changing.
+ */
+export function isRowUpdateRelevant({
+  wasIn,
+  isIn,
+  changedFields,
+  fieldTitles,
+}: {
+  wasIn: ViewMembership
+  isIn: ViewMembership
+  changedFields?: string[]
+  fieldTitles: string[]
+}): boolean {
+  if (wasIn === 'out' && isIn === 'out') return false
+  if (wasIn !== isIn || wasIn === 'unknown' || !changedFields) return true
+  return fieldTitles.some((title) => changedFields.includes(title))
+}
+
+/**
+ * A peer's update to a leaf row of a nested (self-link) list: `skip` it when it didn't touch
+ * the view, `patch` the cached row when none of the fields placing it in the tree changed, and
+ * `reload` the tree otherwise.
+ */
+export function classifyNestedLeafUpdate({
+  wasIn,
+  isIn,
+  isCached,
+  changedFields,
+  positionTitles,
+}: {
+  wasIn: ViewMembership
+  isIn: ViewMembership
+  isCached: boolean
+  changedFields?: string[]
+  positionTitles: Set<string>
+}): 'skip' | 'patch' | 'reload' {
+  if (isIn === 'out') return wasIn === 'out' ? 'skip' : 'reload'
+  if (!changedFields || changedFields.some((title) => positionTitles.has(title))) return 'reload'
+  if (isCached) return 'patch'
+  return wasIn === 'in' ? 'skip' : 'reload'
+}
+
+/** Every column a filter config references (`fk_column_id`, `fk_value_col_id`), at any depth. */
+export function collectFilterColumnIds(node: unknown, out = new Set<string>()): Set<string> {
+  if (Array.isArray(node)) {
+    for (const child of node) collectFilterColumnIds(child, out)
+  } else if (node && typeof node === 'object') {
+    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(node)) {
+      if ((key === 'fk_column_id' || key === 'fk_value_col_id') && typeof value === 'string') out.add(value)
+      else collectFilterColumnIds(value, out)
+    }
+  }
+  return out
+}
+
+/**
+ * Whether a peer's data event can change counts taken under filters over `filterTitles`: a
+ * reorder can't, nor an update whose changed fields include none of them. A filter field the
+ * payload doesn't carry (projected out) may have changed unseen.
+ */
+export function isFilteredCountAffected(data: DataPayload, filterTitles: Set<string>): boolean {
+  if (data.action === 'bulk') return (data.rows ?? []).some((row) => isFilteredCountAffected(row, filterTitles))
+  if (data.action === 'reorder') return false
+  if (data.action !== 'update' || !data.changedFields || !data.payload) return true
+  for (const title of filterTitles) {
+    if (!(title in data.payload) || data.changedFields.includes(title)) return true
+  }
+  return false
+}
+
+/**
+ * Whether a pushed row can belong to a list the viewer narrows client-side: by `searchQuery`
+ * (contains, case-insensitive, over `searchColumns`) and by `filters`. A field the payload
+ * lacks, or a search value that isn't text, can't be judged here and counts as a match.
+ */
+export function rowMayMatchViewerScope({
+  row,
+  searchQuery,
+  searchColumns,
+  filters,
+  columns,
+  evaluateFilters,
+}: {
+  row: Record<string, any>
+  searchQuery: string
+  searchColumns: Array<{ title?: string | null }>
+  filters: FilterType[]
+  columns: Array<{ id?: string | null; title?: string | null }>
+  evaluateFilters: (filters: FilterType[], row: Record<string, any>) => boolean
+}): boolean {
+  const query = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase()
+  const searchTitles = searchColumns.flatMap((col) => (col.title ? [col.title] : []))
+  if (query && searchTitles.length) {
+    const judgeable = searchTitles.every((title) => title in row && (row[title] == null || typeof row[title] === 'string'))
+    if (judgeable && !searchTitles.some((title) => (row[title] ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(query))) return false
+  }
+
+  if (!filters.length) return true
+
+  const ids = collectFilterColumnIds(filters)
+  const titles = columns.flatMap((col) => (col.id && col.title && ids.has(col.id) ? [col.title] : []))
+  if (titles.length < ids.size || titles.some((title) => !(title in row))) return true
+
+  return evaluateFilters(filters, row)
+}
